notes: R-G2B-16 (PR #410 plan, R-G2B-strikes-4-7.md): names and kid text for Strikes #4-7. Strikes #1-3 are already in seal-families-text.json (PB-06) and their unlock lines are in unlock-text.json (PB-14), so the board's 'Strikes #3-7, 5 entries' becomes 4 entries here. Names follow the planner's lean on taste call 2 (Jay's): the redesign shape names, with the real combo as the 'inDojo' line. 'altName' holds the old S4 name (Manager, Oct 24), so Jay's call is a one-line swap and no name is invented. Under the redesign every Strike costs 30 Focus and has Spin Kick's strength; they differ in shape, so the texts describe the shape and never say stronger. 'text' is 12 words or fewer; 'unlock' is 8 words or fewer, first-grade words (same rules as unlock-text.json); 'inDojo' says what the real combo does, from docs/curriculum.md. Hook Kick's text follows the planner's lean A (taste call 1, Jay's): hits the enemy behind a shield enemy. If Jay picks B or D, only this one entry changes. No body-part words, no digits, no 'perfect'.

strikes.name: Side Kick Drive
strikes.text: Step forward and push the enemy away.
strikes.unlock: Your kick now pushes enemies away!
strikes.inDojo: In the dojo: step-behind side kicks, then spin kicks.

strikes.name: Hook Kick
strikes.text: Your kick curves around a shield to reach the enemy behind.
strikes.inDojo: In the dojo: step-behind hook kicks, then front kicks.
strikes.status: waits on taste call 1 (Hook Kick meaning)

strikes.name: Lunge
strikes.text: Rush in fast, then land your kick.
strikes.unlock: Your kick now rushes in fast!
strikes.inDojo: In the dojo: step back twice, then lunge with a front kick.

strikes.name: Spinning Finisher
strikes.text: Spin around and hit every enemy near you.
strikes.unlock: Your spin hits all around you!
strikes.inDojo: In the dojo: finish with a spinning hook kick.
